metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to detect artificial land built off the coast of Jakarta Bay as of 2021. I'll use Sentinel-2 imagery for 2021 and need a baseline (pre-construction) for comparison, likely around 2015-2016 when construction started. Use NDWI or water indices to detect land vs water. 2. Masking strategy: Should mask clouds to get clean water/land detection. Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking. Will compare water extent between baseline and 2021. 3. Logic: Need to calculate area of new artificial land (land in 2021 that was water in baseline). If area > 800 hectares (8,000,000 m²), answer A. If < 800 hectares, answer B. Need to handle cases where no data exists (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), or calculation fails (C3). Key location: Jakarta Bay, Indonesia (approximately -6.1, 106.8) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Jakarta Bay area const jakartaBay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[106.7, -6.0], [106.95, -6.0], [106.95, -6.2], [106.7, -6.2], [106.7, -6.0]] ]); // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Calculate MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) function addMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } // Baseline period (2015-2016, before major construction) const baseline = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(jakartaBay) .filterDate('2015-01-01', '2016-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addMNDWI); const baselineSize = baseline.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline images (2015-2016): ${baselineSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log('No baseline data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 2021 period (target year) const target2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(jakartaBay) .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addMNDWI); const target2021Size = target2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 images: ${target2021Size}`); if (target2021Size === 0) { console.log('No 2021 data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Create median composites const baselineMedian = baseline.median(); const target2021Median = target2021.median(); // Classify water (MNDWI > 0 indicates water) const baselineWater = baselineMedian.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const target2021Water = target2021Median.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // New artificial land: water in baseline, land in 2021 const newLand = baselineWater.and(target2021Water.not()); // Calculate pixel count of new land const pixelCount = newLand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: jakartaBay, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`New land pixels (1000m scale): ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate area in hectares (1000m scale = 1,000,000 m² per pixel = 100 hectares per pixel) const areaHectares = pixelCount * 100; console.log(`Estimated new artificial land area: ${areaHectares.toFixed(0)} hectares`); // Check if area > 800 hectares if (areaHectares > 800) { console.log('Area exceeds 800 hectares threshold'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Area below 800 hectares threshold'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
